summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Morning. Astra opens the central review attachment. Middle image: Astra stares at it. Closing image: A smaller line appears: PROCUREMENT PRIORITY MAY BE ADJUSTED UPON SUCCESSFUL BENCHMARK COMPLETION. Astra stops saying no.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Morning. Astra opens the central review attachment.
PANEL 2 — Large text: WEEKLY MATERIAL TARGET: 240 g.
PANEL 3 — Astra stares at it.
PANEL 4 — Pixa supplies the administrative context.
PANEL 5 — A smaller line appears: PROCUREMENT PRIORITY MAY BE ADJUSTED UPON SUCCESSFUL BENCHMARK COMPLETION. Astra stops saying no.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Mira opens the benchmark calculation. Middle image: Mira looks offended on behalf of arithmetic. Closing image: Astra closes the calculation.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira opens the benchmark calculation.
PANEL 2 — She traces the source data.
PANEL 3 — Pixa displays: OBSERVED: 34 g / ACTIVE VISIT DAY; PROJECTED: 238 g / 7 DAYS; TARGET ROUNDED: 240 g.
PANEL 4 — Mira looks offended on behalf of arithmetic.
PANEL 5 — Jax looks at the target.
PANEL 6 — Astra closes the calculation.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: They multiplied one unusual day by seven.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I also become more productive if you multiply Tuesday by seven.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Zib checks procurement while inspecting the still-temporary brace. Middle image: Zib sees Astra see it. Closing image: Zib closes the procurement screen.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib checks procurement while inspecting the still-temporary brace.
PANEL 2 — Insert on the active station display in Maintenance Bay. Screen: REPLACEMENT PART ETA: 14 DAYS.
PANEL 3 — Astra sees it.
PANEL 4 — Zib sees Astra see it.
PANEL 5 — Astra has not said anything yet.
PANEL 6 — Zib closes the procurement screen.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra reviews the local pilot terms with Mira, Glorp, and Kreeb. Middle image: Glorp checks the exact wording. Closing image: Astra closes the document.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra reviews the local pilot terms with Mira, Glorp, and Kreeb.
PANEL 2 — She points at the boundary.
PANEL 3 — Mira nods.
PANEL 4 — Glorp checks the exact wording.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb looks at Astra.
PANEL 6 — Astra closes the document.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: No behavioral conditions. No invented incidents. No work whose only purpose is output.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Pixa displays the ordinary maintenance calendar. Middle image: Pixa reports. Closing image: Astra answers carefully.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Pixa displays the ordinary maintenance calendar.
PANEL 2 — Three tasks are due within the next ten days: coolant fan vibration check; cargo-bay conveyor service; waste-loop filter inspection.
PANEL 3 — Astra studies the list.
PANEL 4 — Pixa reports.
PANEL 5 — Mira recognizes the thought.
PANEL 6 — Astra answers carefully.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: All three tasks are legitimate scheduled maintenance.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Doing legitimate work early because of the target is still changing the experiment.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: It is also work we have to do.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra asks Zib about the coolant fan vibration check. Middle image: Zib considers honestly. Closing image: Astra takes a beat.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra asks Zib about the coolant fan vibration check.
PANEL 2 — Zib checks the schedule.
PANEL 3 — Astra looks at the workload.
PANEL 4 — Zib considers honestly.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb asks the question Astra hoped no one would.
PANEL 6 — Astra takes a beat before answering, then commits to the one-day move.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Can we do it today without displacing anything?

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: Would you move it without the number?

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: One day early. Nothing else moves.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Zib performs the vibration check. Jax handles access and isolation tags. Middle image: They tighten it and restore the fan. Closing image: Pixa updates the weekly total: TARGET PROGRESS: 19%. Astra notices.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib performs the vibration check. Jax handles access and isolation tags.
PANEL 2 — Mira records the physical maintenance conditions.
PANEL 3 — The check finds a slightly loose mount, worth correcting but not urgent.
PANEL 4 — They tighten it and restore the fan.
PANEL 5 — Later, passive collection from the work area yields a modest sample.
PANEL 6 — Pixa updates the weekly total: TARGET PROGRESS: 19%. Astra notices.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra watches the target graph move upward. Middle image: Mira notices Astra looking at both screens. Closing image: Across the room, the temporary bracket tag remains visible.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra watches the target graph move upward.
PANEL 2 — Procurement status refreshes beside it: PRIORITY REVIEW: IMPROVING.
PANEL 3 — Mira notices Astra looking at both screens.
PANEL 4 — Astra answers without taking her eyes off them.
PANEL 5 — Across the room, the temporary bracket tag remains visible.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Those are not the same result.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra raises the cargo-bay conveyor service with Zib. It is due in six days. Middle image: Astra points at the calendar. Closing image: Astra looks back at the target graph. She does not authorize it yet.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra raises the cargo-bay conveyor service with Zib. It is due in six days.
PANEL 2 — Astra keeps one finger on the six-day conveyor-service entry in the maintenance calendar and looks to Zib.
PANEL 3 — Zib looks at her.
PANEL 4 — Astra points at the calendar.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb, nearby, answers gently.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks back at the target graph. She does not authorize it yet.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We could clear it early too.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: We could also do it in six days.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: It is real maintenance either way.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: The purpose would still be the number.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Mira tests the accumulated passive samples. Middle image: Mira calls Astra over. Closing image: Mira points at the scatterplot.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira tests the accumulated passive samples.
PANEL 2 — One larger sample crumbles under compression.
PANEL 3 — A smaller sample survives longer.
PANEL 4 — Mira calls Astra over.
PANEL 5 — Astra studies the results.
PANEL 6 — Mira points at the scatterplot.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: More mass did not mean better material.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Can you put that in numbers?

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: I can put the absence of a relationship in numbers.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Central review updates the target projection from current collection mass. Middle image: Astra looks at the maintenance calendar again. Closing image: Astra closes the calendar.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Central review updates the target projection from current collection mass.
PANEL 2 — Banner: PROJECTED BENCHMARK STATUS: ON PACE.
PANEL 3 — Pixa reports.
PANEL 4 — Astra looks at the maintenance calendar again.
PANEL 5 — Jax passes with a cargo-access checklist.
PANEL 6 — Astra closes the calendar, then reopens it after Jax leaves.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Why are you looking at next week's problems today?

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Cargo Bay / Dock 2. Opening image: Astra finds Zib in the cargo bay. Middle image: Astra checks the cargo schedule. Closing image: Astra studies the six-day-early conveyor-service schedule, jaw tight, then gives Zib the go-ahead.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra finds Zib in the cargo bay.
PANEL 2 — Astra stands beside the cargo service lane with the schedule open on her tablet, pointing to the empty afternoon window.
PANEL 3 — Zib is less accommodating this time.
PANEL 4 — Astra checks the cargo schedule.
PANEL 5 — Zib looks at her for a long moment.
PANEL 6 — Astra studies the six-day-early conveyor-service schedule, jaw tight, then gives Zib the go-ahead.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Conveyor service. Can we do it this afternoon?

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: It takes the service lane offline.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: No scheduled arrival for three hours.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Cargo Bay / Dock 2. Opening image: The cargo conveyor is isolated. Service panels are open across the loading lane. Middle image: Zib finds nothing significant wrong with the conveyor. Closing image: Pixa updates: TARGET PROGRESS: 31%. Zib looks at the number, then at Astra.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The cargo conveyor is isolated. Service panels are open across the loading lane.
PANEL 2 — Jax sets route barriers and access tags.
PANEL 3 — Mira logs the work conditions because passive collection remains active.
PANEL 4 — Zib finds nothing significant wrong with the conveyor.
PANEL 5 — A modest residue sample appears near a warm motor housing.
PANEL 6 — Pixa updates: TARGET PROGRESS: 31%. Zib looks at the number, then at Astra.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Cargo Bay / Dock 2. Opening image: A station alert interrupts the service: CARGO DOCK 2 — LATCH SENSOR DISAGREEMENT. Middle image: Astra calculates quickly. Closing image: Jax makes the distinction plain.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A station alert interrupts the service: CARGO DOCK 2 — LATCH SENSOR DISAGREEMENT.
PANEL 2 — Jax checks the docking schedule.
PANEL 3 — Zib looks from the open conveyor to Dock 2.
PANEL 4 — Astra calculates quickly.
PANEL 5 — Zib looks at her.
PANEL 6 — Jax makes the distinction plain.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Supply shuttle is twelve minutes out.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Can you close this service first?

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: This is the actual job now.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Cargo Bay / Dock 2. Opening image: Astra checks the half-finished conveyor service. Middle image: Jax reroutes incoming cargo traffic and notifies docking control. Closing image: Astra watches the hold timer increase and knows exactly why.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra checks the half-finished conveyor service.
PANEL 2 — Astra looks from the half-finished conveyor to the shuttle-hold timer and raises one hand to halt further service.
PANEL 3 — Zib does not argue; he starts restoring the conveyor because Astra made the call.
PANEL 4 — Jax reroutes incoming cargo traffic and notifies docking control.
PANEL 5 — Pixa counts elapsed time only.
PANEL 6 — Astra watches the hold timer increase and knows exactly why.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Six minutes. Close clean, then Dock 2.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Supply shuttle holding at approach marker.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Cargo Bay / Dock 2. Opening image: The conveyor is restored. The team moves immediately to Dock 2. Middle image: The latch verifies. Closing image: Zib closes the panel.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The conveyor is restored. The team moves immediately to Dock 2.
PANEL 2 — Zib finds the latch sensor connector partly backed out.
PANEL 3 — Jax secures the dock route while Zib reseats the connector.
PANEL 4 — The latch verifies.
PANEL 5 — The supply shuttle is cleared in, but the station has missed its original turnaround slot.
PANEL 6 — Zib closes the panel. Astra has no answer.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: We moved work for the number and actual work waited.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Back in operations, the target dashboard still reads PROJECTED: ON PACE. Middle image: Astra deletes the remaining accelerated work. Closing image: Pixa asks for clarification and Astra ends the output schedule.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Back in operations, the target dashboard still reads: PROJECTED: ON PACE.
PANEL 2 — Astra looks at the remaining pulled-forward maintenance candidates.
PANEL 3 — She deletes them from the accelerated list.
PANEL 4 — Astra closes the accelerated-work list and restores the ordinary maintenance calendar on the screen.
PANEL 5 — Pixa asks for clarification; Astra answers immediately.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The crew returns to the ordinary maintenance calendar. Middle image: Noola passes the temporary-bracket status display with Astra. NOOLA: You wanted the bracket. Closing image: Noola keeps walking. NOOLA: I know.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The crew returns to the ordinary maintenance calendar.
PANEL 2 — Jax closes the Dock 2 access log.
PANEL 3 — Astra signs the incident note herself.
PANEL 4 — Noola passes the temporary-bracket status display with Astra.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks at the fourteen-day ETA.
PANEL 6 — Noola keeps walking.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Mira updates the forecast using only normal scheduled work. Middle image: Mira shows the full test set. Closing image: Mira is precise.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira updates the forecast using only normal scheduled work.
PANEL 2 — The target projection falls sharply.
PANEL 3 — Astra asks Mira for the material conclusion.
PANEL 4 — Mira shows the full test set.
PANEL 5 — Astra points at the target.
PANEL 6 — Mira is precise.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra brings Zib, Mira, Glorp, Kreeb, Jax, and Pixa into a short standing review beside the actual work board. Middle image: Astra continues. Closing image: Astra answers immediately.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra brings Zib, Mira, Glorp, Kreeb, Jax, and Pixa into a short standing review beside the actual work board.
PANEL 2 — She does not defend the choice.
PANEL 3 — Zib nods once.
PANEL 4 — Astra continues.
PANEL 5 — Glorp opens the report template.
PANEL 6 — Astra answers immediately.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: I moved maintenance for the target.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The final weekly report is assembled. Middle image: Third line: Output-oriented scheduling interfered with normal work and was discontinued. Closing image: Astra presses SEND.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The final weekly report is assembled.
PANEL 2 — First line: Target missed.
PANEL 3 — Second line: Quality varied independently of mass.
PANEL 4 — Third line: Output-oriented scheduling interfered with normal work and was discontinued.
PANEL 5 — Mira reads it.
PANEL 6 — Astra presses SEND.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Central review reports that the benchmark was not met. Middle image: Astra declines the suggested additional collection shift. Closing image: Astra looks at the ordinary work board and explains why.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Central review replies: BENCHMARK NOT MET.
PANEL 2 — Second line: PILOT STATUS REVIEW SCHEDULED.
PANEL 3 — A suggested recovery option appears: OPTIONAL ADDITIONAL COLLECTION SHIFT.
PANEL 4 — Astra selects: DECLINE.
PANEL 5 — Pixa asks for a reason. Astra looks at the ordinary work board before answering.
